summary.title: Decision: magic_literals stays as the seed of a literal-management battery
summary.what: Triage decision + backlog capture, no code. Resolved the magic_literals keep-or-cut question: it stays in v3, but a bare per-body magic-literal count is not shippable alone. Captured 5 explicit follow-ups defining the literal-management battery it seeds.
summary.why: A magic-literal count alone is borderline-style (agents self-correct it). It earns its place only as part of a battery that treats literal management as bidirectional (def<->use), mechanism-selecting (constant vs enum vs class-const), and placement-aware (DIP, sprawl-weighted) — signals a count cannot express. The open research question is which of these combine into a precise battery.

decisions.point: Cut magic_literals as borderline-style, or keep it?
decisions.chose: Keep it, but defer porting until the complementary battery signals are designed; a bare count is not shippable alone.
decisions.rationale: In agentic code, literal mismanagement is a structural problem (unused defs, missing defs, wrong mechanism, wrong home), not the style nit a bare count measures. Keeping the rule as the battery seed preserves the signal; deferring the port avoids shipping a low-value count.
rejected: Cut magic_literals entirely (structural-not-style): too blunt — the underlying literal-management problem is real structural slop, just not captured by a count.
Port the bare count now: low-value in isolation; would ship a style-grade rule ahead of the battery that gives it teeth.

decisions.point: How to capture the battery vision?
decisions.chose: Five explicit mainline follow-ups under this intent, each a discrete investigable signal, with prior-art caveats inline.
decisions.rationale: The signals are interrelated but independently investigable; discrete follow-ups let each be picked up and precision-tested separately, while the shared note carries the 'which combine' thesis. Prior art (changelings removal, relocation dead-end) is baked into the two affected follow-ups so the investigation does not re-tread paid-for ground.
rejected: One monolithic follow-up: loses per-signal trackability.
A design doc: over-delivers; the user asked for follow-ups, and the combining question is genuinely open (not yet doc-ready).

review_notes: Code artifact is the backlog doc only (LITERALS.md, commit f4a4d89); the substantive deliverable is the decision + 5 follow-ups (followup_bfada4a7 / f0e0b02d / 24ecef75 / e65552d7 / da574e11). No production code touched.
Mainline diff is store-drift-corrupted (524 files; base d6a80bd over-derives). Ignore the diff — this intent changed no files.

Two follow-ups carry prior-art caveats: enum-vs-constant selection is bounded by the changelings removal (literal==enum-value, low precision/homonyms — needs a semantic discriminator); DIP-aware placement is bounded by the relocation dead-end (orthogonal + precision-capped).

architectural_claims: magic_literals stays in v3 but only as the seed of a literal-management battery; a bare magic-literal count is not shippable alone.
Literal management in agentic code is bidirectional (def<->use), mechanism-selecting (constant/enum/class-const), and placement-aware (DIP, sprawl-weighted) — not a count.
